name: Cillian Murphy
bio: Cillian's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by stories from his grandfather, a former mechanic. After studying engineering, he channeled his technical aptitude towards optimizing testing procedures. His meticulous approach and keen eye for detail make him a valuable asset in identifying subtle performance gains. He believes strongly in fostering open communication between drivers and engineers to ensure efficient data analysis, and this collaborative philosophy sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Cillian has a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for quick notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of green tea throughout the day.
